title: kith-store: hydrate Message.attachments from AttachmentStore in row_to_message
description:
What: Change row_to_message in kith-store/message.rs to populate Message.attachments from the AttachmentStore instead of returning empty vec.

Algorithm:
1. Locate row_to_message in kith-store/src/message.rs (currently: attachments: vec![]).
2. row_to_message must gain access to a Connection (or take &AttachmentStore). Choose: pass conn: &Connection as parameter, construct AttachmentStore::new(conn) inside.
3. Call store.attachments().list_by_message(&msg_id) -> Vec<Attachment>.
4. Propagate errors as KithError::Store.
5. Update all callers of row_to_message to pass conn.

Defensive rules: no unsafe; errors propagated, not unwrapped; empty vec is correct when no attachments exist (not an error).

Agent team: R reads all callers of row_to_message; I updates row_to_message signature and all callers; T adds test: insert message with 2 attachments, get message, verify attachments array length=2 and fields match; V runs cargo test -p kith-store + clippy.
